newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Oct palm oil output 880,000t - Ivan Wong.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Oct palm oil output 880,000t - Ivan Wong.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in October was estimated at 880,000 tonnes, up 1.8 percent over September, private crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Thursday.
This was unchanged from his earlier estimate.

Wong also maintained his earlier estimate of end-October palm oil stocks at 965,000 tonnes, against the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) figure of 894,030 tonnes at end-September.
Wong had in his earlier report estimated palm oil exports in October at 710,000 tonnes, a record high, against an estimated 680,000 tonnes shipped in September.
Official October crop figures from PORLA are due on Friday.
Wong said in his latest report that the modest increase in production was contributed entirely by an additional working day in October.
"Production for the whole of this year now looks likely to reach 8.41 million tonnes as against 7.81 million tonnes in 1995," he said.

Wong said stocks at the end of October comprised 605,000 tonnes of crude palm oil and 360,000 tonnes of processed palm oil. He said output of palm kernel/palm kernel oil also continued to exceed offtake, resulting in a further build-up in stocks of about 18,000 tonnes to an estimated 185,000 tonnes, oil basis, in October.
